Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number(4);
 temp_batch_id varchar2(14);
 temp_unit varchar2(15);
 temp_x varchar2(1);
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('0179');
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM utrs
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 AND nvl(test_chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND cancel_flag is null
 AND (tb_id is null
 or
 (tb_id is not null and
 (:s_testing_lab_code = '99' or
 :s_testing_lab_code in 
 (SELECT testing_lab_code from test_batch_det
 WHERE tb_id = utrs.tb_id
 AND test_chapter_id = utrs.test_chapter_id)
 )
 )
 ) ; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('0205',' or lab code does not match');
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 IF UNIT_LABELED THEN
 show_error('9321');
 :check_flag := 'Y';
 END IF;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 v_sysdate date;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_2.coll_Date is not null
 then
 
 -- time zone change --04/29/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else

 begin

 then

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL

declare
cursor c3 is
 select distinct test_id
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and nvl(chapter_id,'XX') = nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,'XX')
 and nvl(coll_date,sysdate) = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,sysdate) 
 and cancel_flag is null
 and (tb_id is null or
 (tb_id is not null and
 exists (select 'x'
 from test_batch_det
 where test_batch_det.tb_id = utrs.tb_id
 and test_batch_det.test_chapter_id = utrs.test_chapter_id
 and (:s_testing_lab_code = '99' or
 (testing_lab_code = :s_testing_lab_code)
 )
 )
 )
 )
 order by test_id;
BEGIN
 go_block('valid_tests');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 for c3_rec in c3
 loop
 :valid_tests.test_id := c3_rec.test_id;

 begin
 select test_desc
 into :valid_tests.s_test_desc
 from valid_tests
 where test_id = c3_rec.test_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate +1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 down;
 end loop;

 go_record('1');
 go_item('valid_tests.s_select_flag');
end;

PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 where_clause VARCHAR2(2000);
 where_clause3 VARCHAR2(500);
 where_clause2 VARCHAR2(500); 
 temp_count number;
 v_test VARCHAR2(300);
 temp_n_ctr number(3) := 0; 
 v_code_string VARCHAR2(300);
 v_code VARCHAR2(300);
 temp VARCHAR2(300);
BEGIN
begin
 go_block('valid_tests');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :valid_tests.s_select_flag = 'X'
 then
 temp_n_ctr := temp_n_ctr + 1; 
 v_code := v_code||''''||:valid_tests.test_id||''''||',';
 -- v_code_string := v_code_string||:valid_tests.test_id||',';
 end if;
 
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 go_record('1');
 IF temp_n_ctr = 0 THEN 
 go_block('valid_tests');
 go_record('1');
 show_error('5170'); 
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 temp := rtrim(v_code, ',');
 
end;
 begin
 :system.message_level := 5;

 if :ctrl_blk_2.group_test_id is null and temp is not null then
 where_clause := ' unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and nvl(coll_date, sysdate) = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date, sysdate) '||
 ' and nvl(chapter_id , :global.chapter_id) = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id, :global.chapter_id) '||
 ' and cancel_flag is null '||
 ' and ((tb_id is null) or (tb_id is not null and exists (select ''x'' from '||
 ' test_batch_det where test_batch_det.tb_id = utrs.tb_id and '||
 ' test_batch_det.test_chapter_id = utrs.test_chapter_id and '||
 ' ((:s_testing_lab_code = ''99'') or (:s_testing_lab_code != ''99'' and '||
 ' testing_lab_code = :s_testing_lab_code))))) ';
 where_clause2 := '('||temp||')'; 
 where_clause := where_clause ||
 ' and test_id in '||
 where_clause2;
 end if;
 go_block('utrs');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 set_block_property('utrs', default_where, where_clause);
 :system.message_level := '5';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 
 if :utrs.test_id is not null then
 GO_ITEM('utrs.s_select_flag');
end if;
if :utrs.test_id is null then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0205');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PERFORM_COMMIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE perform_commit IS
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_coll_date date;
 temp_chapter_id VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_test_id VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_result_code VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(80);
 chk_flag_utrs varchar2(1) := 'N';
 t_ui_count number;
 t_ua_count number;
begin
 :system.message_level := 10;
 /* Insert UTRS Data */
 go_block('UTRS');
 first_record;
 loop
 IF :utrs.s_select_flag = 'X' THEN
 begin
 temp_unit_id := :utrs.unit_id;
 temp_coll_date := :utrs.coll_date;
 temp_chapter_id := :utrs.chapter_id;
 temp_test_id := :utrs.test_id;
 temp_result_code := :utrs.result_status_1;
 chk_flag_utrs := 'Y';
 insert into test_voids
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_seq_no, test_id,
 test_state, test_mode, result_status_1, result_status_2,

PROCEDURE create_qcre(p_test_id in varchar2) IS
 required_test number(4);
 u_no_of_ok_comp number(4);
 pl_contract_id varchar2(14);
 pl_contract_type varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 
 --- Check if the contract ID is internal
 begin
 select contract_id into pl_contract_id from units where
 unit_id=:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 null;
 end;

 --- check the contract type
 
 If pl_contract_id='INTERNAL' then 
 null;
 Else
 begin
 select contract_type into pl_contract_type from CONTRACTS
 where contract_id=pl_contract_id and rownum=1; 
 exception when others then 
 null;
 end;
 End If; 


 --This has been derived from the Core Routine
 
 If pl_contract_id='INTERNAL' or nvl(pl_contract_type,'XX')!='RG' then 
 
 -- V02
 SELECT count(*)
 into required_test
 from contract_tests ct, units u
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and u.chapter_id = ct.chapter_id
 and u.contract_id = ct.contract_id
 and ct.test_id = p_test_id
 and sysdate between ct.eff_date and nvl (ct.term_date, sysdate)
 and ct.stop_label_flag = 'Y';
 
 Elsif pl_contract_type='RG' then 
 
 -- V02
 SELECT count(*)
 into required_test
 from contract_tests ct, units u, batch_inputs bi
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 and u.batch_id = bi.batch_id
 and ct.profile_set_id = bi.profile_set_id
 --and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id --- added for 2018R3
 --and u.chapter_id = ct.chapter_id 
 and u.contract_id = ct.contract_id
 and ct.test_id = p_test_id
 and sysdate between ct.eff_date and nvl (ct.term_date, sysdate)
 and ct.stop_label_flag = 'Y';
 --
 End If;
 
 if required_test > 0 then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into u_no_of_ok_comp
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and nvl(coll_date,sysdate+100) = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,sysdate+100)
 and nvl(chapter_id,'NULL') = nvl(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,'NULL')
 and qc_test_Date is not null;
 end;
 if u_no_of_ok_comp = 0
 then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into u_no_of_ok_comp
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and system_label_decision in
 (
 select code from master_codes
 where code_type = 'OKABO'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 );
 end;
 end if;
 if u_no_of_ok_comp > 0 then
 BEGIN
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (
 unit_id,
 coll_date,
 chapter_id,
 inter_code,
 insert_dats,
 inter_user_id,
 source_test_id,
 program_id
 )
 values
 (
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'QCRE',
 sysdate,
 :banner.user_id,
 p_test_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 );
 exception
 when dup_val_on_index then 
 null;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Added by Kishore on 03/22/2012. IM 7703
-- Resetting the QC flag while voiding or cancelling a test
PROCEDURE RESET_QC_FLAG IS
 cursor c1(p_batch_id in varchar2) is
 select unit_id, qc_test_flag, qc_test_date
 from units
 where batch_id = p_batch_id
 and chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id;
 
 t_batch_id units.batch_id%type;
 t_contract_id units.contract_id%type;
 t_dummy_count number;
 t_count number := 0;
 t_test_count number := 0;
 t_prev_qc_test_flag reset_qc_date_log.prev_qc_test_flag%type;
 t_prev_qc_test_date reset_qc_date_log.prev_qc_test_date%type;
 t_prev_results_qc_date reset_qc_date_log.prev_results_qc_date%type;
 t_prev_results_qc_user reset_qc_date_log.prev_results_qc_user%type;
 t_tb_id utrs.tb_id%type;
 t_batch_qc varchar2(1);
 t_reset_recs_present varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 --message('Test'); pause;
 t_reset_recs_present := 'Y';
 --message('RQF-Test'); pause;
 begin
 select batch_id, contract_id
 into t_batch_id, t_contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :utrs.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_batch_id := null;
 t_contract_id := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --message('RQF-Test1'); pause;
 
 if nvl(t_contract_id, '*') != 'INTERNAL' then
 go_block('UTRS');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :utrs.s_select_flag = 'X' then
 --message('Test ID: ' || :utrs.test_id); pause;
 -- Check whether record exists in the RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 begin
 select count(*) -- Replaced "'x'" with "count(*)". Replaced by Kishore on 05/17/2012. IM 8638
 into t_dummy_count -- Replaced "t_dummy" with "t_dummy_count". Replaced by Kishore on 05/17/2012. IM 8638
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = :utrs.unit_id
 and test_id = :utrs.test_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 --t_dummy := null; -- Commented by Kishore on 05/17/2012. IM 8638
 t_dummy_count := 0; -- Added by Kishore on 05/17/2012. IM 8638
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 -- Count the number of tests that match with the tests in RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 --if t_dummy = 'x' then -- Commented by Kishore on 05/17/2012. IM 8638
 if t_dummy_count > 0 then -- Added by Kishore on 05/17/2012. IM 8638
 t_count := t_count + 1;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 --message('Count from form: ' || t_count); pause;

 -- Count the number of tests in RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_test_count
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = :utrs.unit_id
 and action_flag is null;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --message('Count from New Table: ' || t_test_count); pause;
 
 -- If number of tests in RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table is greater than the number of 
 -- tests marked to be cancelled in the form, then some tests have not been cancelled.
 -- So the unit has to be QC'd (QC_TEST_DATE and QC_TEST_FLAG should be left as null)
 if t_test_count > t_count then
 --message('Test1'); pause;
 null;
 else
 --message('Test2'); pause;
 --message('RQF-Test2'); pause;
 begin
 select prev_qc_test_flag, prev_qc_test_date
 into t_prev_qc_test_flag, t_prev_qc_test_date
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = :utrs.unit_id
 and prev_qc_test_flag is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date = (select max(prev_qc_test_date)
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = :utrs.unit_id
 and prev_qc_test_flag is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date is not null)
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_reset_recs_present := 'N'; -- Added by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 --message('Record not inserted into RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table'); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 --raise form_trigger_failure; -- Commented by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --message('RQF-Test3'); pause;
 
 -- Update only if records are present in the RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 -- Records will not be present if tests are ordered for a new unit
 if t_reset_recs_present = 'Y' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 begin
 update units
 set qc_test_flag = t_prev_qc_test_flag,
 qc_test_date = t_prev_qc_test_date
 where unit_id = :utrs.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if; -- if t_reset_recs_present = 'Y' then
 --message('Test3'); pause;
 end if;
 
 -- Loop through all the units in the batch to see if any of the units have to be QC'd
 --message('Test4'); pause;
 t_batch_qc := 'N';
 for c1rec in c1(t_batch_id) loop
 --message('Unit ID: ' || c1rec.unit_id); pause;
 if c1rec.qc_test_flag is null and c1rec.qc_test_date is null then -- Unit has to be QC'd
 --message('Test5'); pause;
 t_batch_qc := 'Y';
 end if;
 end loop;
 
 t_reset_recs_present := 'Y'; -- Added by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 -- If all the units in the batch do not have to be QC'd then the batch does not have to be QC'd
 if t_batch_qc = 'N' then 
 --message('Test6'); pause;
 --message('RQF-Test4'); pause;
 begin
 select prev_results_qc_date, prev_results_qc_user
 into t_prev_results_qc_date, t_prev_results_qc_user
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and prev_results_qc_date is not null
 and prev_results_qc_user is not null
 and prev_results_qc_date = (select max(prev_results_qc_date)
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and prev_results_qc_date is not null
 and prev_results_qc_user is not null)
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_reset_recs_present := 'N'; -- Added by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 --message('Record not inserted into RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table'); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 --raise form_trigger_failure; -- Commented by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --message('RQF-Test5'); pause;
 
 -- Update only if records are present in the RESET_QC_DATE_LOG table
 -- Records will not be present if tests are ordered for a new unit
 if t_reset_recs_present = 'Y' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 begin
 update batch_inputs
 set results_qc_date = t_prev_results_qc_date,
 results_qc_user = t_prev_results_qc_user
 where batch_id = t_batch_id
 and chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if; -- if t_reset_recs_present = 'Y' then
 --message('Test7'); pause;
 end if;
 --message('Test8'); pause;
 
 go_block('UTRS');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :utrs.s_select_flag = 'X' then
 begin
 update reset_qc_date_log
 set action_flag = 'C'
 where chapter_id = :utrs.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = :utrs.unit_id
 and test_id = :utrs.test_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 end if; --if nvl(t_contract_id, '*') != 'INTERNAL' then
END;
-- End of change

Trigger.Name: PERFORM_COMMIT_UTRS
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_coll_date date;
 temp_chapter_id VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_test_id VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_result_code VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
if :utrs.s_select_flag = 'X' and :utrs.void_reason is not null then
 if :GLOBAL.change_block = 'UTRS'
 then
 go_block('UTRS');
 begin
 temp_unit_id := :utrs.unit_id;
 temp_coll_date := :utrs.coll_date;
 temp_chapter_id := :utrs.chapter_id;
 temp_test_id := :utrs.test_id;
 temp_result_code := :utrs.result_status_1;
 -- :ctrl_blk_2.chk_flag_utrs := 'Y';
 insert into test_voids
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_seq_no, test_id,
 test_state, test_mode, result_status_1, result_status_2,
 tb_id, test_chapter_id, tb_seq_no, well_number, absorbance,
 ratio, result_dats, result_user_id, testing_lab_code,
 insert_dats, insert_user_id, void_type, void_reason_code,
 void_dats, void_user_id)
 values
 (:utrs.unit_id, :utrs.coll_date, :utrs.chapter_id,
 :utrs.test_seq_no, :utrs.test_id, :utrs.test_state,
 :utrs.test_mode, :utrs.result_status_1,
 :utrs.result_status_2, :utrs.tb_id,
 :utrs.test_chapter_id, :utrs.tb_seq_no,
 :utrs.well_number, :utrs.absorbance, :utrs.ratio,
 :utrs.result_dats, :utrs.result_user_id,
 :utrs.testing_lab_code, :utrs.insert_dats,
 :utrs.insert_user_id, 'C', :void_reason,
 sysdate, :banner.user_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in test voids');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :utrs.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :utrs.cancel_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 -- Since this is a database block, a post is required
 post;
 -- Calling database procedure to update interdiction, etc.
 temp_return_val := test_results.unit_void(
 temp_unit_id,
 temp_coll_date,
 temp_chapter_id,
 temp_test_id,
 temp_result_code,
 :banner.prog_name);
end if; 
 if temp_return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Unit interdictions procedure not run successfully');
 message('Result status = '||temp_return_val);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 null;
 else
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 next_record;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-PREV-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.cursor_value is not null
 then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 PREVIOUS_ITEM;
end;
